text:
jaspreet: quick sync — we need to lock per-card max-batch / max-tokens targets for the continuous-batching heuristic. saw a perf regression on H100 when we bumped max_tokens to 8192 yesterday, digging in now.

kevin: saw that too. p99 jumped ~18% and throughput down ~12% on long-context chat workloads. profiler shows kernel fallbacks to slow matmul path when sequence > 6k and kv-frag > 0.3.

maria: kv cache fragmentation sounds plausible — lots of short/long mixed requests cause cache blowups. when cache misses, kernel selector chooses fallback kernels that don't use the optimized fused-attn.

sam: can we gate by both max_batch_tokens and kv-frag? i.e., if kv-frag > 0.25 reduce max_tokens to avoid fragmentation-induced fallbacks.

jaspreet: yes — proposing per-GPU baseline + adaptive reduction rule. initial proposal (rough):
- A10: max_batch_size 32, max_batch_tokens 4096
- T4: max_batch_size 16, max_batch_tokens 2048
- L4: max_batch_size 24, max_batch_tokens 3072
- A100: max_batch_size 48, max_batch_tokens 8192
- H100: max_batch_size 64, max_batch_tokens 12288
These are conservative; H100 numbers were aggressive before and caused kernel fallbacks.

kevin: numbers look reasonable. i'd be more conservative on H100 for mixed-entropy workloads — drop H100 to 10k initially. also add a kernel-fit test: if kernel_selector fallback_ratio > 0.05 over 5m, autoprovide a softcap decrease of 20%.

maria: +1 to fallback_ratio. also add a KV-aware packing policy: prefer packing tokens from same session (prefix share) to avoid KV fragmentation. we have partial code in the queueer branch.

sam: putting an experiment matrix together. plan: run 24h A/B across priority production lanes, measure p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, and kernel_fallback_ratio. experiment variants: baseline (current prod), conservative-per-gpu (jaspreet proposal), kv-aware-packing, adaptive-fallback-gating.

jaspreet: posting config snippet for the conservative-per-gpu variant — tweakable via rollout flags:

```
{
  "policy_name": "conservative_per_gpu_v1",
  "device_profiles": {
    "A10": {"max_batch_size": 32, "max_batch_tokens": 4096},
    "T4":  {"max_batch_size": 16, "max_batch_tokens": 2048},
    "L4":  {"max_batch_size": 24, "max_batch_tokens": 3072},
    "A100":{"max_batch_size": 48, "max_batch_tokens": 8192},
    "H100":{"max_batch_size": 64, "max_batch_tokens": 10000}
  },
  "adaptive_rules": [
    {"trigger":"kernel_fallback_ratio>0.05","action":"scale_max_tokens:-20%","window":"5m"},
    {"trigger":"kv_frag>0.25","action":"scale_max_tokens:-25%","window":"2m"}
  ]
}
```

kevin: runbook note: when we lower max_tokens automatically we should also log the metric that triggered it and emit a trace link. that helps postmortem for regressions.

infra-bot: scheduled experiment job INF-2345 created. 3 clusters (canary/prodA/prodB) assigned. start time: 3769998000.

sam: added perf checklist to the experiment:
- kernel_selector fallback_ratio (per-device)
- kv_frag ratio and avg kv miss latency
- tokens/sec and p99 latency per workload class
- cost delta (GPU utilization and per-token cost)

maria: small profiling note — when kv-frag spikes we see a lot of small GEMM kernels that thrash L2 caches on A10/T4. for those cards, reduce max_batch_size first (cheaper) before chopping max_tokens.

jaspreet: good call. update: adaptive_rules ordering: first scale_batch_size -15% on kv_frag>0.2, then scale_max_tokens if fallback persists.

kevin: can we add a quick microbenchmark to validate kernel selection boundaries? i can run microbench across model sequence lengths [512,1024,2048,4096,8192,12288] and dump selected kernels + exec times.

jaspreet: please run and drop results here. assign ticket INF-2346 for kernel-boundary map.

kevin: starting the run now. rough example of the benchmark command i use:
```
./perfbench --device H100 --model redwood-chat-7b --seq-lens 512,1024,2048,4096,8192,12288 --warmup 200 --iter 1000 --trace kernel_selector
```

sam: reminder for rollout policy: keep canary limited to 5% traffic and auto-rollback if p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.15 for >10m.

maria: also capture allocations for KV cache — leak patterns have looked like fragmentation at ~0.3 threshold. if we see sustained kv_frag > 0.35 we should disable prefix packing temporarily.

jaspreet: OK — action items:
1) kevin runs microbench and posts kernel-selection map (INF-2346) — due EOD.
2) sam to launch A/B with configs (INF-2345) and hook metrics dashboard.
3) maria to land KV-aware packing flag behind rollout.
4) infra to ensure experiment job has alerting and trace links.

jospreet: (typo) meant jaspreet :P

kevin: posted initial kernel map gist: https://gist.github.com/kevin/abcd1234 (contains kernel names + runtimes). early highlight: optimized fused-attn drops when seq>6k on A100/H100 when packing mixes sessions.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for conservative_per_gpu_v1 on cluster prodA at 3769998200. monitoring endpoints: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/runtime/batching-experiments

sam: will monitor dashboards and post interim summary in ~2h.

jaspreet: thanks team — goal: finalize safe defaults for GA by end of next week after 72h stable runs.

kevin: noted. i'll also test a variant that forces kernel_selector "prefer_fused_attn=true" to measure cost/latency tradeoffs (may increase memory usage).

maria: adding that variant to the experiment matrix.

sam: interim note (30m in) — canary shows slight improvement in tokens/sec for A10/T4, H100 steady but p99 marginally improved vs yesterday's aggressive config. will report full metrics after 2h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
